typography.guidelines: Ensure strong distinction between heading and body fonts. The heading font (Outfit) brings institutional authority yet approachability, while the body font (IBM Plex Sans) provides maximum legibility for neurodiverse users.

colors.guidelines: Strict adherence to WCAG 2.1 AAA high contrast. Avoid hyper-saturated, bright, or vibrating colors (no neon). Use deeper, earthy tones for Teal and Indigo in light mode to maintain calmness and high contrast. Backgrounds should be soft and matte.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid (No Glassmorphism). Use warm, flat solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders to prevent visual refraction and sensory overload.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal, soft ambient shadows only (shadow-sm or none). Avoid harsh or deep drop-shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200/border-slate-700) to ground elements clearly.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for large cards, rounded-xl for interactive elements, pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs.

component_name.cards: shadcn/ui Card (Customized to be flat with 1px border)
component_name.dialog: shadcn/ui Dialog (For Grant Proposal and CSR forms)
component_name.accordion: shadcn/ui Accordion (For FAQs or dense topic summaries)
component_name.badge: shadcn/ui Badge (For Publication categories and tagging)
component_name.toast: sonner (For interactive feedback, CSR proposal submission)

grids.services_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Create visual asymmetry. Mobile Clinic (col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2), Maternal Protocol (col-span-4 row-span-1), Training Centers (col-span-4 row-span-1), Pediatric Rehab (col-span-full).
grids.dashboard_data: High density grid for CSR transparency metrics (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6).

layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-8, p-12 for containers, py-24 or py-32 for section vertical padding to reduce sensory clutter and cognitive load.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and paragraphs. Center-align hero headlines if balanced with structural asymmetry below.
layouts.header: Solid or semi-solid (backdrop-blur-md ONLY if heavily tinted) background. Sticky z-50. Must always remain highly legible.

motion.philosophy: ZERO AUTO-PLAYING MOTION. Strict adherence to neuro-accessibility.
motion.interactions: Use simple, predictable state changes. Transform scale (scale-105) on hover for cards, but ONLY if the user initiates it. Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: 'transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out' or 'transition-transform duration-200'.

accessibility.contrast: WCAG 2.1 AAA. Ensure all text and interactive elements have at least 4.5:1 against their backgrounds (7:1 preferred for normal text).
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard navigability. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., ring-2 ring-teal-500 ring-offset-2).
accessibility.semantics: Screen-reader semantic HTML (nav, main, section, article). Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='csr-submit-button').

media.guidelines: Images must be used with transparent or solid background overlays (max bg-black/40) for text legibility. Never use placeholder URLs.

3d_libraries.reasoning: 3D libraries, fast motion, or parallax are strictly disabled for this project to maintain strict neuro-accessibility (preventing vertigo, sensory overload, or distraction). Stick to high-quality 2D imagery and semantic typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided (Slate-900, Slate-50, Teal-600, Indigo-600) and map them intelligently to Light/Dark modes.
Do not implement generic Vercel/Stripe styles. Use Flat Solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders and generous padding to create a calm, institutional feel.
All forms (Research Grant, CSR Request, Contact) must use Shadcn form components, and include toast notifications via Sonner for success/error states.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on EVERY button, tab, accordion trigger, and form input.
Provide a 'Light/Dark mode toggle' in the global header.
Implement the 'Publications Hub' as a filterable/searchable interface using Shadcn Tabs or custom filter logic.
For the 'Crowdfunding' section, utilize Shadcn Progress bars to show funding milestones for individual children.
Never use automatic carousels or marquees. All sliders/galleries must be manually controlled by the user.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid over-using shadows in this neuro-accessible context.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Respect natural reading flows.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-xl) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap and cause cognitive overload.
Missing categories or images? Use the provided URLs only. NO PLACEHOLDER TEXT/IMAGES.
Use sonner for toasts, located at /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or similar path depending on setup.
